item.title: The role of climate change in the Nepal floods
item.description: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.
item.content:encoded: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.

item.title: Ratko Mladic, the 'Butcher of Bosnia' convicted of genocide, is dead at 84
item.description: The "Butcher of Bosnia" is dead — Ratko Mladic, the Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide, has died at 84 while serving a life sentence in The Hague.
item.content:encoded: The "Butcher of Bosnia" is dead — Ratko Mladic, the Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide, has died at 84 while serving a life sentence in The Hague.

item.title: Scientists map the interactions of key proteins linked with profound autism
item.description: After more than a decade, UCSF scientists have mapped around 100 varied genes associated with profound autism to a smaller set of biological pathways, offering a promising path for developing drugs.

item.title: The Sisyphean path it took to get 'Coyote vs. Acme' to the big screen
item.description: Warner Brothers' decision three years ago to shelve a live action animated movie with Wile E. Coyote and the Roadrunner upset many fans. Here's what its release tells us about Hollywood economics.

item.title: Syria's breakaway Kurds relinquish autonomy and rejoin the country
item.description: Syria's Kurds, once backed by the U.S. to fight ISIS, have relinquished autonomy and dissolved their army to rejoin Syria.

item.title: Political bickering follows two deaths related to measles in Pennsylvania
item.description: This week, Pennsylvania officials reported two measles-related deaths. Those deaths have now become wrapped up in politics. The country is in the midst of a record-setting number of measles cases.

item.title: A drug just approved for pancreatic cancer opens a new chapter in treatment
item.description: The FDA just approved a breakthrough drug for metastatic pancreatic cancer, which is notoriously hard to treat. In clinical trials, the new pill roughly doubled how long patients survived.

item.title: The fight over Trump's name on the Kennedy Center isn't over
item.description: The legal fight over President Trump's name on the Kennedy Center isn't over. Rep. Joyce Beatty explains why she believes the board's latest plan still violates the law.

item.description: The prosecution and defense gave closing statements in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, the mom accused of killing her three small children.
